text: CJP leader Abhijeet Dipke said the party will support but not physically join the INDIA bloc rally at Ramlila Maidan, citing its neutral platform, Hindustan Times reports. He made the comment after meeting Mamata Banerjee, and police have deployed about 10,000 personnel for the event, with capacity estimates of 50,000, the report adds.

sources.title: CJP backs INDIA bloc's Ramlila Maidan rally, but won't participate in it, says Dipke; cites ‘neutral platform’ identity | India News - Hindustan Times
sources.articleText:
Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke has said that while the outfit supports the INDIA bloc's rally at Ramlila Maidan against CEC Gyanesh Kumar, it will not participate in it.
Dipke said the CJP supported the cause but would maintain its independent identity. He added that the issue of alleged electoral irregularities was not limited to any one organisation and that the CJP would extend support to groups raising concerns over alleged vote theft. Follow INDIA bloc rally LIVE updates here.
“We support the protest tomorrow, we stand in solidarity, but the Cockroach Janta Party is an independent organisation; it is a neutral platform, and we want to keep it that way,” he said after meeting former West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee on Saturday.
“Anybody who will fight against this vote theft, we will support all organisations,” he said.
